title: Daily English Words Practice
description: Practise useful everyday English words with simple definitions, example sentences and a short vocabulary test.
learning_objectives: Review words through a short quiz

body_markdown:
## 1. Ten useful words

| Word | Meaning | Example sentence |
|---|---|---|
| arrive | reach a place | I arrive at work at nine. |
| borrow | take something and return it | May I borrow your pen? |
| choose | select one thing | Please choose a seat. |
| decide | make a choice | We will decide tomorrow. |
| explain | make something clear | Please explain the rule. |
| follow | go after or obey | Follow the instructions. |
| improve | become better | I want to improve my English. |
| invite | ask someone to come | I will invite my friend. |
| return | come or give back | Please return the book. |
| share | give part or use together | We share the information. |

## 2. Notice the difference

- **Borrow:** receive something temporarily. “Can I borrow your book?”
- **Lend:** give something temporarily. “Can you lend me your book?”
- **Bring:** carry something towards the speaker or a place. “Please bring your ID card.”
- **Take:** carry something away or with you. “Please take this file.”

## 3. Make your own examples

Choose five words from the table. Write one sentence for each word about your home, work or daily life.

## 4. Fill in the blanks

Use: **arrive, explain, improve, borrow, choose**.

1. I want to ______ my speaking skills.
2. Can I ______ your notebook?
3. Please ______ the answer again.
4. We ______ at the station early.
5. You can ______ any one of these books.

**Answers:** 1. improve, 2. borrow, 3. explain, 4. arrive, 5. choose.

## 5. Speaking task

Speak for one minute using at least five words from this lesson. Try to use each word correctly in a complete sentence.

## 6. Revision habit

Learn five words at a time. Review yesterday's words before adding new ones.

faq.question: How many English words should I learn daily?
faq.answer: Start with five useful words and learn how to use them in sentences.

faq.question: What is the difference between borrow and lend?
faq.answer: Borrow means receive something temporarily; lend means give something temporarily.

faq.question: How do I remember new words?
faq.answer: Write an example sentence, say it aloud and revise the word after a day or two.
